safety_precautions: ensure workspace is clear of hazards

steps.description: Measure the dimensions of the left armrest to create a matching right armrest.
Cut the wood to the required dimensions for the new armrest.
Sand the edges of the cut wood to ensure a smooth finish.
Attach the new armrest to the chair frame using wood glue and screws.
Clamp the armrest in place and allow the glue to dry according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Finish or paint the armrest to match the rest of the chair.

tips: Ensure all measurements are accurate before cutting.
Allow adequate drying time for glue.
Test the stability of the armrest after installation.
